description: This file defines an abstract class 'RelationalStorageForTesting' used for setting up, managing, and testing relational database storage in unit tests. It includes methods for creating, dropping, and checking databases, executing setup scripts, and managing connection strings for different database providers. The class also handles loading SQL scripts for schema setup and provides factory methods for creating instances based on database invariants.

classes.name: RelationalStorageForTesting
classes.description: An abstract class providing utilities for setting up and managing relational database storage in testing scenarios, including database creation, deletion, and script execution.

methods.name: SetupInstance
methods.description: Asynchronously sets up a test database instance by creating or recreating the database and executing schema setup scripts.

methods.name: CreateTestInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of RelationalStorageForTesting based on the database invariant name.

methods.name: ExecuteSetupScript
methods.description: Executes a setup script in the test database by converting it into executable batches.

methods.name: ExistsDatabaseAsync
methods.description: Checks asynchronously whether a database with the specified name exists.

methods.name: CreateDatabaseAsync
methods.description: Creates a new database with the specified name asynchronously.

methods.name: CopyInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the storage with the same connection string but a different database name.
